{{Quote|The Alliance is getting better at hiding their deflector shields. Look there, at the fringe of the settlement. I want a single, ''surgical strike'' to that auxiliary power generator there&hellip; followed by a ''ground assault''.|[[Demmings]]|<ref name="Empire 35" />}}
Eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''destroyed''' a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ejolus]] which was home to a colony of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees.
